personality_one_liner: A premium, high-trust SaaS environment that balances operational density with calming whitespace, echoing Stripe and Linear.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding around content to avoid overcrowding. Cards never flush to screen edges; always use md or lg margin. Group related elements tightly (xs/sm) while separating distinct sections broadly (xl/2xl).

do's: Use blur on the sticky bottom tab bar.
Use blur for sticky headers when scrolling content passes underneath.
Use blur on bottom-sheet drag handles/headers for POS checkout.
dont's: Never blur standard cards, form inputs, or data table rows.
Avoid heavy glassmorphism on dense data screens to preserve maximum readability.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level status page summarizing KPIs, revenue trends, and sync status for immediate operational clarity.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and chart area.
states.empty: N/A - Demo data or zero-states shown structurally.
states.error: Card showing connection error with 'Retry Sync' button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with Command/Search icon, profile avatar, and a persistent 'Offline/Sync' status pill. Top section has a row of 2-column KPI cards (Sales, Expenses). Middle section holds a Line Chart for revenue trends with horizontal scrollable period filter chips above it. Bottom section shows a prioritized list of Alerts or Unpaid Invoices. Background is surfaceSecondary (#F8FAFC) with surface (#FFFFFF) cards.

screens.name: POS / Kasir
screens.purpose: Rapid transaction processing optimized for one-handed cashier operation and high-glare environments.

states.loading: Spinner centered in the product grid.
states.empty: Illustration of a basket with 'Mulai tambahkan produk ke keranjang'.
states.error: Toast or banner above cart showing 'Gagal memuat produk'.

screens.layout: Split-viewport architecture: Top 60% is a category pill rail and a 2-column grid of product tiles (image + name + price). Bottom 40% is a persistent sliding Cart sheet showing added items (tabular numerals for prices) and a prominent sticky 'Charge / Bayar' CTA pinned safely above the home indicator in the thumb zone.

screens.name: Invoice & Quotation
screens.purpose: Minimalist document builder to create, preview, and send professional invoices on the go.

states.loading: Skeleton rows mimicking invoice line items.
states.empty: Clean desk illustration with 'Belum ada invoice bulan ini' and a primary CTA 'Buat Invoice'.
states.error: Error banner with 'Gagal memuat daftar invoice'.

screens.layout: List view uses clean cards with customer name, ID, amount, and Status pills (Lunas, Pending, Overdue). Builder view uses a single-column scroll layout with 'click-to-open' edit fields for line items (no modals), keeping context intact. Sticky 'Preview & Save' button fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: Menu / Drawer
screens.purpose: Secondary navigation hub for accessing Inventory, Customers, Finance, Docs, and Settings.
screens.layout: Rendered as a full-screen sheet or the last tab ('Lainnya'). Vertical list of menu items with Phosphor icons in brandTertiary tinted containers. Clean dividers between logical groups (Modules vs Settings).

instructions_to_main_agent: COLORS: Use the user-provided exact hex codes for the palette. Do NOT use default Material or iOS blues, stick to Primary #2563EB, text #0F172A, background #F8FAFC, and surface #FFFFFF.
TYPOGRAPHY: Exclusively use 'Inter' for both display and text families as requested by the user. Ensure font sizes scale properly using the provided base.
LAYOUT - SAAS FEEL: Emulate Stripe/Linear premium SaaS quality. Use 1px borders (#E2E8F0) and shadow tier 1 (subtle, directional) for cards. Maintain generous internal padding (16px/24px).
LAYOUT - POS: Build the POS screen using an ergonomic bottom-heavy layout. The 'Charge' button must be in the lower 30% of the screen (thumb zone).
OFFLINE SYNC: Place a persistent but subtle sync status pill (e.g., 'Offline', 'Syncing...', 'Up to date') in the global header or dashboard top area.
TEXT ON IMAGES: For the auth/splash screen or any card using the `auth_hero` background, apply the mandatory top-to-bottom 3-stop gradient scrim to ensure text readability.
NO EMOJIS: Do not use emojis anywhere in the system UI. Rely on Phosphor icons inside `brandTertiary` tinted rounded squares for list rows and settings items.
TABULAR DATA: Where prices and quantities align (e.g., POS Cart, Invoice Builder), align monetary values to the right to maintain vertical alignment.
